title: Brain implants link experiencers to the gray hive mind

tellings.quote: It turns you into a walking bug and it and it connects you to the gray hive of mind. They told me that too.

plain: Implants put in people's brains are said to connect them to a shared group mind of the grays, the small gray-skinned beings of abduction accounts. A scientist named Steve Colbern, who studies objects said to be alien implants taken from human bodies, says the implant "turns you into a walking bug" and "connects you to the gray hive of mind," adding that he was told this himself: "They told me that too." If true, people who report these encounters would be linked into an alien collective without knowing it.
